content: pykrx scrapes KRX+Naver. KRX lacks adjusted-close but has delisted stocks; Naver has adjusted-close but not delisted — pykrx prioritizes Naver. Known issue: adjusted=True sometimes returns values WITHOUT dividend adjustment (GitHub #162). Index queries (e.g. kosdaq) via get_market_ohlcv_by_date can return empty (#158). Internal ticker dedup: KOSPI 1xxx / KOSDAQ 2xxx. KRX server blocks bursts so 1s delay between calls is built in. Delisted-stock adjusted prices unreliable (#89).
